title: .fwos/local/runs/<kind>/<target>.json
description: One test of fwos's harness, as `fwos harness record` keeps it, or one run of the team's own test script, as `fwos tests run` keeps it: what it saw, the revision of the code it ran on, and the harness that recorded it, if any. It counts only while both are current.

kind.description: states: one page's or component's state fixtures. ia: one role and flag setting. tests: one of the team's test scripts.

target.description: page.<id> or component.<id> for states; the role and the flags on, joined by +, for ia; the script for tests, after its folder and a / outside the root.

fwos.description: The fwos version that recorded it.

sha.description: The content hash of the harness file when it ran.

harness.description: The harness file that ran; null for a run of the team's own tests, which no harness of fwos's recorded.

revision.description: The content hash of what a run of the app depends on, when it ran; null when the code changed during the run.

config.description: How it ran: the server, the browser, the viewport, or the command fwos ran.

observations.description: What it saw: one entry per state for states, the visits and nav for ia, the script's run for tests.

testRun.description: One run of a test script, as `fwos tests run` ran it.

dir.description: The folder of that package.json, . for the root.

display.description: How the team runs it: pnpm test.

command.description: The script's command, as package.json has it.

runner.description: The runner fwos recognised, or null.

browser.description: The runner drives a real browser.

mapped.description: fwos read its results, so they count as evidence.

reason.description: Why its results don't count, when they don't.

results.description: Its result files, relative to the root.
